title: Tencent Hy-MT1.5 Mobile Machine Translation
summary: A compact multilingual translation model optimized for on-device mobile use through extreme compression. It delivers high-tier performance across 33 languages with minimal hardware requirements.
research_notes: Introduced terminology intervention and context-aware multi-turn translation support; integrated into Tencent Meeting and Enterprise WeChat.

evolution.summary: Updated in mid-2026 with 1.25-bit quantization via the Sherry framework, reducing the 1.8B model to 440MB for deployment on low-end mobile hardware. It is currently the industry benchmark for offline on-device translation.
